title: Wed 07 Oct 2026: Records on Wall Street, Fed minutes tonight, FRAME deadline moves to 22 Oct, EU pauses Level 2 rules
summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq close at records while Treasury and gilt yields stay near multi-decade highs and oil trades on Hormuz headlines. The Fed publishes its September minutes tonight; the FCA's FRAME consultation now closes on 22 October, and the European Commission is pausing non-essential Level 2 rules until October 2027. Plus Capel's launch, Apollo's daily pricing, three COO action points and the week's diary.
